typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MCOInternalAppealNumber as string,
		{Appeal Type} as string,
		AppealStatus as string,
		Extension as string,
		Recon as string,
		TypeServiceDenied as string,
		Determination as string,
		ReasonForAppeal as string,
		MemberName as string,
		MedicaidIDofMember as string,
		ProviderNPI as string,
		AuthorizedRepresentativeRelationship as string,
		AuthorizedRepresentativeName as string,
		ReasonAppealUpheld as string,
		AppealNarrative as string,
		DateReceived as string,
		DateAcknowledgementLetterSent as string,
		DateAppealResolutionLettersent as string,
		DateCompletedResolved as string,
		AgeofBeneficiary as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource
ExcelSource derive(Process_Type = 'Appeals_Vendor') ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of ReasonAppealUpheld} = toString(ReasonAppealUpheld),
		{Copy of MCOInternalAppealNumber} = toString(MCOInternalAppealNumber),
		{Copy of Extension} = toString(Extension),
		{Copy of DateAppealResolutionLettersent} = toString(DateAppealResolutionLettersent),
		{Copy of DateCompletedResolved} = toString(DateCompletedResolved),
		{Copy of Process_Type} = toString(Process_Type),
		{Copy of AgeofBeneficiary} = toString(AgeofBeneficiary),
		{Copy of AppealStatus} = toString(AppealStatus),
		{Copy of ReasonForAppeal} = toString(ReasonForAppeal),
		{Copy of ProviderNPI} = toString(ProviderNPI),
		{Copy of AppealNarrative} = toString(AppealNarrative),
		{Copy of DateReceived} = toString(DateReceived),
		{Copy of AuthorizedRepresentativeRelationship} = toString(AuthorizedRepresentativeRelationship),
		{Copy of TypeServiceDenied} = toString(TypeServiceDenied),
		{Copy of MemberName} = toString(MemberName),
		{Copy of Recon} = toString(Recon),
		{Copy of DateAcknowledgementLetterSent} = toString(DateAcknowledgementLetterSent),
		{Copy of Determination} = toString(Determination),
		{Copy of MedicaidIDofMember} = toString(MedicaidIDofMember),
		{Copy of AuthorizedRepresentativeName} = toString(AuthorizedRepresentativeName)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion derive({Copy of MCOInternalAppealNumber} = {Copy of MCOInternalAppealNumber}) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		MedicaidIDofMember as string,
		DateCompletedResolved as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		AppealType as string,
		ReasonForAppeal as string,
		DateReceived as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Determination as string,
		AgeofBeneficiary as integer,
		ProviderNPI as string,
		TypeServiceDenied as string,
		MCOInternalAppealNumber as string,
		Extension as string,
		AppealNarrative as string,
		AppealStatus as string,
		ReasonAppealUpheld as string,
		AuthorizedRepresentativeRelationship as string,
		DateAppealResolutionLettersent as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PROCESS_TYPE as string,
		AuthorizedRepresentativeName as string,
		DateAcknowledgementLetterSent as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MemberName as string,
		Recon as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		MedicaidIDofMember = {Copy of MedicaidIDofMember},
		DateCompletedResolved = {Copy of DateCompletedResolved},
		AppealType = {Copy of Appeal Type},
		ReasonForAppeal = {Copy of ReasonForAppeal},
		DateReceived = {Copy of DateReceived},
		Determination = {Copy of Determination},
		AgeofBeneficiary = {Copy of AgeofBeneficiary},
		ProviderNPI = {Copy of ProviderNPI},
		TypeServiceDenied = {Copy of TypeServiceDenied},
		MCOInternalAppealNumber = {Copy of MCOInternalAppealNumber},
		Extension = {Copy of Extension},
		AppealNarrative = {Copy of AppealNarrative},
		AppealStatus = {Copy of AppealStatus},
		ReasonAppealUpheld = {Copy of ReasonAppealUpheld},
		AuthorizedRepresentativeRelationship = {Copy of AuthorizedRepresentativeRelationship},
		DateAppealResolutionLettersent = {Copy of DateAppealResolutionLettersent},
		PROCESS_TYPE = {Copy of Process_Type},
		AuthorizedRepresentativeName = {Copy of AuthorizedRepresentativeName},
		DateAcknowledgementLetterSent = {Copy of DateAcknowledgementLetterSent},
		MemberName = {Copy of MemberName},
		Recon = {Copy of Recon})) ~> OLEDBDestination
